skill.nostalgiaskills.marksman.heavy_bol: Crossbows hit much harder, but you walk slower while holding one.
skill.nostalgiaskills.marksman.patient_a: Shots from far away hit harder; shots from up close hit weaker.
skill.nostalgiaskills.marksman.volley_do: Your projectiles hit harder, but your melee attacks hit weaker.
skill.nostalgiaskills.artificer.master_e: You mine much faster, but your tools wear out sooner.
skill.nostalgiaskills.artificer.tinkers_: Your tools last much longer, but you mine slower.
skill.nostalgiaskills.artificer.wayfinde: You move faster and fall farther without getting hurt, but you lose 2 hearts.
skill.nostalgiaskills.berserker.death_wi: Near death your melee hits are devastating, but healing works worse on you.
skill.nostalgiaskills.berserker.juggerna: Heavy weapons hit harder and you are hard to push around, but you attack slower.
skill.nostalgiaskills.berserker.reckless: You deal more melee damage, but you also take more damage.
skill.nostalgiaskills.duelist.swift_hand: You swing light weapons much faster, but each hit is a little weaker.
skill.nostalgiaskills.duelist.thousand_c: You land critical hits far more often, but each one is weaker.
skill.nostalgiaskills.duelist.wind_dance: You dodge attacks more often, but you lose 2 hearts.
skill.nostalgiaskills.guardian.bastion.t: You have much more health, but you move slower.
skill.nostalgiaskills.guardian.living_ae: You take less damage from everything, but your attacks are weaker.
skill.nostalgiaskills.guardian.rooted_st: You are very hard to push and better armored, but you jump lower.
You are a bit harder to push; when your health is low you briefly take less damage.
skill.nostalgiaskills.arcanist.arcane_wa: Magic hurts you much less, but your attacks are weaker.
skill.nostalgiaskills.arcanist.elixir_of: Healing works much better on you, but you have less health.
skill.nostalgiaskills.arcanist.tincture_: Your potions last longer and drinking one heals you a little.
skill.nostalgiaskills.arcanist.volatile_: Your potions last much longer, but magic hurts you more.
Firearms hit harder; a headshot makes you stronger and reloading makes you faster for a moment.
skill.nostalgiaskills.duelist.flurry_fin: With a weapon in each hand you hit harder, and finishing a combo makes you faster for a moment.
skill.nostalgiaskills.guardian.ring_bear: You can wear one more ring, but you lose 2 hearts.
skill.nostalgiaskills.guardian.charm_kee: You can wear one more charm, but you have less armor.
skill.nostalgiaskills.guardian.slider_re: Only a pickaxe can break the Slider, and now yours breaks everything else: holding a pickaxe, you deal 6 more attack damage. Hidden until you beat the Slider.
skill.nostalgiaskills.duelist.valkyrie_g: You fight like a Valkyrie: you reach 2 blocks farther with attacks and hands, and falling never hurts you. Hidden until you beat the Valkyrie Queen.
skill.nostalgiaskills.arcanist.sun_spiri: Your body burns like the Sun Spirit's: fire and lava barely hurt you and whoever hurts you catches fire, but freezing hurts twice as much. Hidden until you beat the Sun Spirit.
skill.nostalgiaskills.artificer.brass_in: When you are hurt, a gust of wind throws back every enemy within 6 blocks, once every 8 seconds. Hidden until you clear the Brass Dungeon.
skill.nostalgiaskills.guardian.naga_scal: You charge like the Naga: while sprinting, your melee blows deal 30% more damage and send the target flying. Hidden until you defeat the Twilight Forest Naga.
skill.nostalgiaskills.arcanist.lich_pact: Press the Hidden Power key to raise a Loyal Zombie beside you that fights for you for 30 seconds, once every 20 seconds. Hidden until you defeat the Lich.
skill.nostalgiaskills.berserker.hydra_he: Cut off one head and another grows: every time you are hurt you gain one more level of Strength, up to III, for 6 seconds. Hidden until you defeat the Hydra.
skill.nostalgiaskills.marksman.ghast_tea: Every kill with a projectile sheds a ghast tear on you: Regeneration II for 5 seconds. Hidden until you defeat the Ur-Ghast.
skill.nostalgiaskills.duelist.frozen_cou: Your fully drawn shots carry the Snow Queen's frost: the target is Frosted and slowed for 5 seconds. Hidden until you defeat the Snow Queen.
skill.nostalgiaskills.berserker.ignis_em: Your critical hits set the target on fire and sear Ignis' Blazing Brand into it for 10 seconds. Hidden until you defeat Ignis.
skill.nostalgiaskills.duelist.ender_guar: When an enemy hurts you, you blink behind it, once every 12 seconds. Hidden until you defeat the Ender Guardian.
skill.nostalgiaskills.marksman.harbinger: Your fully drawn shots lock on like the Harbinger's eye: the target glows through walls for 10 seconds and withers for 6. Hidden until you defeat the Harbinger.
skill.nostalgiaskills.guardian.leviathan: When you are hurt the abyss answers: every enemy within 5 blocks suffers the Leviathan's Abyssal Burn for 5 seconds, once every 10 seconds. Hidden until you defeat the Leviathan.
skill.nostalgiaskills.arcanist.maledictu: When your health falls below 30% you turn into a ghost for 4 seconds: nothing can hurt you, but you cannot attack or use items. Once every 3 minutes. Hidden until you defeat Maledictus.
skill.nostalgiaskills.marksman.scylla_st: Your fully drawn shots call Scylla's storm: lightning strikes the target for 5 hearts of damage, once every 8 seconds. Hidden until you defeat Scylla.
skill.nostalgiaskills.berserker.dragonba: Your critical hits encase the target in dragon ice for 3 seconds, once every 15 seconds. Hidden until you kill a dragon.
skill.nostalgiaskills.artificer.hydra_se: Your critical hits bite like a hydra's fangs: they poison the target and heal you for a heart, once every 5 seconds. Hidden until you kill a hydra.
skill.nostalgiaskills.artificer.serpent_: While wet, in water or in the rain, you swim 50% faster and your attacks deal 20% more damage. Hidden until you kill a sea serpent.
skill.nostalgiaskills.guardian.frostmaw_: Press the Hidden Power key to roar like Frostmaw: every enemy within 6 blocks is frozen solid for 3 seconds, once every 30 seconds. Hidden until you defeat Frostmaw.
skill.nostalgiaskills.berserker.wroughtn: While sneaking you stand like the Wroughtnaut: melee blows hurt 60% less and nothing pushes you. Hidden until you defeat the Ferrous Wroughtnaut.
skill.nostalgiaskills.arcanist.umvuthi_s: Press the Hidden Power key to call a sunstrike down on the block you are looking at, up to 32 blocks away, once every 5 seconds. Hidden until you defeat Umvuthi.
skill.nostalgiaskills.artificer.kraken_t: Your critical hits drag every enemy within 8 blocks toward you, like the Kraken's trident, once every 10 seconds. Hidden until you defeat the Kraken.
skill.nostalgiaskills.marksman.sandworm_: Your critical hits erupt under the target like a sand column and throw it into the air, once every 6 seconds. Hidden until you defeat the Sandworm.
skill.nostalgiaskills.duelist.knights_oa: You strike at the weak spot first: your blow against an unhurt enemy deals 50% more damage. Hidden until you defeat the Underworld Knight.
skill.nostalgiaskills.duelist.warlords_w: Your critical hits spin a cobweb around the target's feet, once every 8 seconds. Hidden until you defeat the Spider Warlord.
skill.nostalgiaskills.berserker.pumpkin_: Whatever you kill bursts like a pumpkin bomb, dealing 4 hearts of damage to the enemies around it. Hidden until you defeat Lord Pumpkinhead.
skill.nostalgiaskills.artificer.shipbrea: A blow that would kill you leaves you with one heart instead, once every 5 minutes. Hidden until you survive the Shipbreaker.

skill.nostalgiaskills.marksman.stigma_of: While you carry the Curse of Prudence, your fully drawn shots shatter on impact and deal 3 hearts of damage to the enemies around the target, so no single foe takes it all. Once every 5 seconds. Hidden until you wear that curse.

skill.nostalgiaskills.berserker.fafnirs_: +20% critical damage, and your critical hits set the target on fire for 5 seconds, once every 10 seconds. Hidden until you wear the Rune of Fafnir.
skill.nostalgiaskills.marksman.eye_of_th: A fully charged shot that hits releases a gust that throws back the enemies within 6 blocks of you. Once every 10 seconds. Hidden until you kill the Eye of the Storm.
skill.nostalgiaskills.berserker.minotaur: The Hidden Power key throws you forward in a charge. Once every 10 seconds. Hidden until you kill the Minoshroom.
skill.nostalgiaskills.guardian.phantom_g: Blocking an attack with a shield heals 1 heart. Once every 6 seconds. Hidden until you kill a Knight Phantom.
skill.nostalgiaskills.duelist.alpha_grip: Your critical hits freeze the target in place: Slowness IV for 3 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. Hidden until you kill the Alpha Yeti.
skill.nostalgiaskills.arcanist.gorgon_ga: Your critical hits turn the target to stone for 2 seconds (Slowness V). Once every 12 seconds. Hidden until you kill a Gorgon.
skill.nostalgiaskills.berserker.cyclops_: Your critical hits burst for 8 damage on the enemies around the target. Once every 10 seconds. Hidden until you kill a Cyclops.
skill.nostalgiaskills.arcanist.dread_har: Killing an enemy gives you Absorption II for 10 seconds. Once every 5 seconds. Hidden until you kill a Dread Lich.
skill.nostalgiaskills.artificer.sculptor: You step up full blocks without jumping and fall 5 blocks further without harm. Hidden until you kill the Sculptor.
skill.nostalgiaskills.marksman.naga_spit: A fully charged shot poisons the target: Poison II for 5 seconds. Once every 5 seconds. Hidden until you kill a Naga from Mowzie's Mobs.
skill.nostalgiaskills.berserker.infernal: Your critical hits set the target on fire for 8 seconds, once every 8 seconds, and you take 50% less fire damage. Hidden until you kill the Infernal Dragon.
skill.nostalgiaskills.guardian.yeti_pelt: 80% less freezing damage taken and +2 armor. Hidden until you kill the Yeti from Block Factory's Bosses.
skill.nostalgiaskills.duelist.captains_f: Dodging an attack gives you Speed II for 3 seconds. Once every 5 seconds. Hidden until you kill the Pirate Captain.
skill.nostalgiaskills.guardian.krampus_c: When you are hurt, the attacker is caught in a web. Once every 12 seconds. Hidden until you kill Krampus.
skill.nostalgiaskills.arcanist.stolen_br: Killing an enemy heals 1 heart. Once every 2 seconds. Hidden until you kill the Lifestealer in its true form.
skill.nostalgiaskills.berserker.headless: +25% damage while your health is low. Hidden until you kill Lord the Headless.
skill.nostalgiaskills.artificer.captains: +30% swim speed and your breath lasts much longer under water. Hidden until you kill Captain Cornelia.
skill.nostalgiaskills.marksman.mothers_l: A fully charged shot that hits makes the enemies within 12 blocks of you glow for 10 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. Hidden until you kill the Maze Mother.
skill.nostalgiaskills.artificer.piglich_: +3 hearts and 15% less magic damage taken. Hidden until you kill a Piglich.
skill.nostalgiaskills.guardian.undying_s: When your health runs low you refuse to fall: Regeneration III and Resistance II for 5 seconds. Once every 2 minutes. Hidden until you kill a monster with the Undying trait.
skill.nostalgiaskills.artificer.chaos_he: Your critical hits unleash chaos on the target, at random: a lightning bolt, a launch into the air, fire, or a blast that hurts the enemies around it. Once every 4 seconds. Hidden until you kill the Chaos Guardian.
attribute.name.nostalgiaskills.harvest_b: Chance that a ripe crop you break yields one extra crop or essence.
message.nostalgiaskills.telescope.no_sta: The stars cannot be seen from here right now: it takes an Overworld night and open sky.
gui.nostalgiaskills.status.rank_up: Click to mark rank %s for %s point(s); click again for the next ones.
gui.nostalgiaskills.status.rank_pending: %s rank(s) marked — click to mark one more.
gui.nostalgiaskills.status.refundable_sh: Shift-click to unlearn every rank and get its points back.
command.nostalgiaskills.regenerate_warni: This draws the whole skill tree again from the current catalog, as a new world would get it. Skills that are no longer in the tree are refunded to every player (offline players when they log in). Run /nostalgiaskills regenerate confirm to do it.
command.nostalgiaskills.regenerated: Skill tree drawn again: %s skills. Players were reconciled and refunded for skills that left the tree.
gui.nostalgiaskills.status.rank_pending_: Every rank left is marked — click again to unmark them.
